scenarios.name: Place an order
scenarios.reason:
Added Colombia Huila to the bag and opened the bag.
Confirmed shipping was €4.90 and the bag total was €17.90.
Proceeded to checkout and entered Ada Lovelace’s name, ada@example.com, 12 Rua Augusta, and Lisbon.
Placed the order successfully; the confirmation says order TS-5907 is in and €17.90 was charged.

scenarios.name: Free shipping from €50
scenarios.reason:
Added House Espresso and Paper Filters to the bag as requested.
Opened the bag and confirmed shipping was €4.90 with a total of €49.40.
Pressed the plus button next to Paper Filters once; shipping updated to Free and the total updated to €51.00.

scenarios.name: Promo code total
scenarios.reason:
Added Ethiopia Guji to the bag twice and added one Hand Grinder.
Opened the bag and applied the lowercase promo code welcome10.
The promo code was applied successfully: the discount is −€9.10, shipping is Free, and the total is €81.90.
